source: Phase-3 DECOMPOSITION profile. Recipe v1.0 with the day-log format knobs set so that ONE 5-min description record fills ONE block: segment_seconds=300, block_segments=1. TEST-ONLY: it forks recipe_id, so nothing trained under it is comparable to a v1.0 artifact, and it is not a publish candidate.
note: Every TRAINING knob is byte-identical to consolidation-v1.0 and to consolidation-test-1min-v1.0 (48x amplification, 15% deny-then-correct, LoRA r128/a256 CPT 3ep, 30% replay from amp). Only the day-log FORMAT differs. Against the 1-min profile this changes two things at once, deliberately: it restores the parity amplification dose (one description per block instead of five, so 48 retellings cover ~1.4k chars again rather than ~5.7k) AND it removes the multi-record concatenation (block_segments=1 means build_daylog never joins two caption records under one 'Scene:' label). The question it answers is not which of those mattered - it is whether the REAL pipeline can carry parity block content to parity numbers.
